fn spin(n: Int) -> Int
  example spin(1) == 1
do
  return spin(n + 1)
end fn

fn ping(n: Int) -> Int
  example ping(1) == 1
do
  return pong(n + 1)
end fn

fn pong(n: Int) -> Int
  example pong(1) == 1
do
  return ping(n + 1)
end fn

fn fib(n: Int) -> Int
  example fib(40) == 102334155
do
  if n < 2 then
    return n
  else
    return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
  end if
end fn
